decisions.reason: Ending the project and removing further terminal exploration does not change the established peak-alignment rule or make any of its current attributes obsolete.
The project-ending decision does not revise or cancel the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes in the artwork being delivered.
The removal of terminal exploration and instruction to stop revisions does not alter the established common-baseline relationship.
The source decision concerns project termination, geometry failures, and delivery of working files; it does not change the accepted formats for viewable iteration proofs.
